entities.name: Kartal Surp Nişan Armenian Orthodox Church
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Kartal Surp Nişan Armenian Church is an Armenian Church located in Kartal Municipality, Istanbul. The facility was built in the 16th century as a chapel. It collapsed and was rebuilt as a school and church in 1776.
